title: CERN Technical Studentships 2027-1
summary: CERN technical studentship in electronics, applied physics, computing, materials or mechanical engineering.
eligibility: Enrolled students meeting minimum completed-semester and discipline requirements.

prize.description: Cash prize value is not established or is not applicable.

notes: Requires 18 months or three completed semesters by selection.
Programme lasts 4–12 months; reported allowance CHF 3,486 per month before insurance contribution.
